spans.s:
mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
Ignorant, unwise, foolish.
E.
अ priv. and ज्ञ who knows.

f. (-ज्ञा)
An order, a command.
E.
आङ्, ज्ञा to know, and अङ् aff.

f. (-ता)
Ignorance; also अज्ञत्व.
E.
ता added to अज्ञ.

Unknown.
2

Unknowing.
E.
अ neg. ज्ञात known.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Ordered, commanded.
E.
आङ् before ज्ञा to know, affix क्त.

n. (-त्वं)
Ignorance.
E.
अज्ञ and त्व aff.

Ignorance.
2

Spiritual ignorance, wordly illusion or belief in external appearances.
mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Ignorant, unwise.
E.
अ neg. and ज्ञान knowledge.

f. (-ता)
Ignorance, also अज्ञानत्वं.

mfn. (-नी-निनी-नि)
Ignorant, unwise.
E.
अ neg. ज्ञानिन् knowing.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Incomprehensible.
E.
अ neg. ज्ञेय to be known.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
Ordered, commanded.
E.
आङ् before ज्ञप causal of ज्ञा and क्त affix; also आज्ञापित.

f. (-प्तिः)
Order, command.
E.
आङ् before ज्ञा to know, with क्तिन् aff.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Obeying, obedient, performing an order.
m. (-रः)
A servant.
E.
आज्ञा and कर who makes.

n. (-णं)
Obedience, execution of orders.
E.
आज्ञा and करण doing.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Obedient, ministrant, one who obeys or executes orders.
E.
आज्ञा and कारिन् who acts.

n. (-क्रं)
A mystical circle or diagram, one of six described by the Tantras.
E.
आज्ञा and चक्र a circle.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
Obeying or executing orders, obedient.
E.
आज्ञा, अनु according to, यायिन् who goes.

mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिनी-र्त्ति)
Obeying or executing orders.
E.
आज्ञा, अनु according to, and वर्त्तिन् who abides.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Obedient, obeying or executing orders.
E.
आज्ञा, अनु according to, सारिन् who goes.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Giving orders, a commander, commanding.
E.
आङ् before ज्ञा to know, causal form, वुन aff.

n. (-त्रं)
An edict, a written order.
E.
आज्ञा and पत्र a page.

n. (-नं)
Ordering, commanding.
E.
आङ् before ज्ञा to know, causal form, ल्युट् aff.

m. (-तः)
Disobedience, rebellion.
E.
आज्ञा and प्रति घात rebelling.

m. (-ङ्गः)
Disobedience, insubordination, disloyalty.
E.
आज्ञा and भङ्ग breaking.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Obedient, subject, ministrant.
E.
आज्ञा and वह who bears.

mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि)
Obedient, submissive.
E.
आज्ञा and सम्पादिन् who executes.
